$comment: Tuning constants. Kept out of code so balance can be changed without touching either runtime.
$comment_yield: Decomposition is lossy on purpose: breaking a crafted thing returns only this fraction of its inputs' essence (min 1 per element). Without it, composition doubles every craft tier and a late-game item would decompose into hundreds of elements.

levelCurve.$comment: XP required to advance FROM level n TO n+1 is base * n^exponent, rounded to the nearest 5.

$comment_gather: gatherRadius plus the player radius is the pickup range. At 168 px/s a radius of 34 left only ~0.56s in range walking straight over a node, and under 0.3s clipping its edge - shorter than the time it takes to see the prompt and move a thumb. gatherGraceSeconds keeps the last node gatherable briefly after you pass it, so a slightly late tap still lands.
